name: Con Su
source:
Owner of the Frozen Nirvana, a junk shop located in the Hyper Ghetto. 

A highly-skilled hacker, her true face is that of an information broker.

Frequently does business with the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency.

A complete shut-in who never leaves her store.

[Spoiler]Was formerly held in captivity at the Ikebukuro CPC, where she was close friends with [url=/c34599]Hogyo Iria[/url].

Went to great lengths to search out Iria's whereabouts after the Ikebukuro CPC was dissolved; Iria's escape from The Fortress was facilitated by none other than Con Su.[/spoiler] 

[From the in-game profile]
